title: Am i ready to be unbanned???

replies.author: rinn
replies.body:
Hello,

Since many months have passed since your ban, your appeal will be accepted. However, if you are banned again, your chances of appealing your infraction will be significantly low. Please be sure to read the updated rules (http://avicus.net/rules), and welcome back to the server.

Regards,
Rinn
Avicus Network Senior Moderator
